thread:
Harper (Finance): Quick sync: planning a tiny pricing experiment to compare new per-token tiers vs current tiered bundles. Primary ask today: agree explicit rollback gates and CSV visibility so billing ops can act fast.

Drew (Billing): Sounds good. For visibility please add `pricing_arm=A|B`, `preview_only=true|false`, and `prorate_policy=none|immediate|on_renewal` to invoice previews.

Samira (RevOps): I'll prepare the customer-facing preview copy. For any live flips we should give 72h notice and a self-serve opt-in. During preview we'll label emails: "Billing preview: no charges applied". :mailbox_with_mail:

Ethan (Product): From API side we'll add `active_pricing_arm` and `proration_behavior` to /billing and /account. Also shipping a small smoke test that sends system-role-heavy messages to catch token accounting shifts.

Lucia (Billing Ops): Rollback gates proposal:
- Abort if refunds_count > 2 in canary window
- Abort if per-account token_delta_pct > 5% for >0.5% of canary accounts
- Abort if more than 1 previewed invoice accidentally escapes preview state
- Auto-rollback if any live invoice > $500 unexpectedly changes
I'll also ensure preview invoices have `preview_only=true` so they never hit payment processor.

Harper (Finance): Nice. Add a soft gate for customer support signals: if >3 support tickets referencing "unexpected bill" are opened within 24h for canary accounts, pause rollout.

Drew (Billing): I'll produce a sample CSV today with columns: account_id,billing_period,plan,pricing_arm,preview_only,prorate_policy,invoice_preview_amount,tokens_billed. Will run `csvdiff` vs baseline and post results to the ticket.

Samira (RevOps): Drafts incoming. I'll include an FAQ on proration (annual stays on old rates until renewal unless they opt in) and steps to opt in.

BillingBot: Ticket FIN-8234 created by Harper (Finance): "A/B pricing experiment - rollback gates & CSV schema". https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-8234

Ethan (Product): Also request a lightweight eval that simulates batched and unbatched traffic; sometimes runtime batching changes token counts. Keep eval under 200 queries but varied.

Lucia (Billing Ops): I'll add a reconcile job in staging to compare per-account token counts to production baseline and alert if >5% variance. Also will add an automated rollback action in the feature-flag system.

Harper (Finance): Great. Meeting tomorrow 9:30 to approve canary window. Owners: Drew => CSV + csvdiff, Lucia => feature-flag rollback + reconcile, Samira => comms + FAQ, Ethan => API fields + eval. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
